lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in an irregular grid of approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, transitioning to more scattered distribution toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of spots, creating a lattice-like appearance on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a superior light-to-inferior shadow gradient; the most prominent ridge originates posterior to the eye and runs horizontally along the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters distributed unevenly across the first dorsal fin, with higher concentration near the base and trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark horizontal linear indentation or scar is visible on the posterior mid-section of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of micro-spots (sub-pixel level relative to flank spots) located on the dorsal surface of the head.
